title: Second Largest Digit in a String
summary: For an alphanumeric string s, identify the second highest digit present, or return -1 if no second highest digit exists.
statement: For an alphanumeric string s, identify the second highest digit present, or return -1 if no second highest digit exists. An alphanumeric string includes lowercase letters and digits.
constraints: The input contains lowercase letters and decimal digits.
Return the second-largest distinct digit, or -1 when fewer than two distinct digits occur.
hints: Track the largest and second-largest distinct digit seen so far.
Ignore letters; when a new maximum arrives, demote the old maximum to second.
Otherwise update second only for a value strictly between it and the maximum.
The two variables maintain the top two distinct digits after every character, so the final second value is correct or remains -1.
editorial: The two variables maintain the top two distinct digits after every character, so the final second value is correct or remains -1.

tests.explanation: Distinct digits are one, two, and three, so the second largest is two.
Only digit one occurs, so there is no second-largest distinct digit.
